Honda — Four years producing honda.com across two agencies and two redesign systems, plus the Acura Vehicles site.

The staple of the Honda Automobiles company is their .com site. Working on this for 4 years at both Razorfish and RPA was an incredible experience. Having gone through two different redesign systems, each agency attempted to provide a different strategy for how to work on this website.

Another main aspect of this site are all the tools needed to help users find inventory, estimate payments, build their own custom vehicle and browse the selection of dealers for each car. On the Acura side, the luxury approach meant fewer vehicles and richer, more detailed content for each one.
